subject.title: fix: harden Mattermost slash callback auth

question: Should Mattermost native slash registration fail closed for every non-HTTPS callback URL, including explicit HTTP URLs, before this PR merges?
rationale: The code change is small, but the policy choice changes a token-bearing security boundary and can break existing Mattermost HTTP callback deployments.

options.title: Require HTTPS fail-closed
options.body: Merge the transport gate after live proof and refreshed PR context show HTTPS registration works and HTTP callbacks stop before registration.

options.title: Stage the policy
options.body: Ask for a compatibility-preserving or opt-in strict-mode design if maintainers are not ready to break HTTP callback deployments.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior
options.body: Decline this PR if preserving existing HTTP deployments is more important than the cleartext token transport hardening.

recommendation.title: Require HTTPS fail-closed
recommendation.body: Merge the transport gate after live proof and refreshed PR context show HTTPS registration works and HTTP callbacks stop before registration.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to the monitor helper split and adjacent slash token hardening, making them the best available routing owner from the code trail.
